_readme: Revalor / VisionWorkx ecosystem database. Every tool, database and service the company runs on, and the capabilities each provides. The analyzer checks recommended modules against this file to flag delivery gaps. Items marked 'To confirm' were not known when this file was created — fill them in on the Ecosystem screen.

capabilities.name: App hosting
capabilities.description: Run web apps and APIs we build for clients.

capabilities.name: Database
capabilities.description: Store client records, leads, bookings, jobs, inventory.

capabilities.name: Client logins
capabilities.description: Secure sign-in for business owners, staff and their customers.

capabilities.name: Embeddable widgets
capabilities.description: Script-tag widgets that run on WordPress, Squarespace, Webflow, Framer, Wix.

capabilities.name: Form submission API
capabilities.description: Receive widget/form submissions with spam protection.

capabilities.name: Transactional email
capabilities.description: Confirmations, alerts, reminders — with SPF/DKIM on client domains.

capabilities.name: Email campaigns
capabilities.description: Lists, campaigns, follow-up sequences, unsubscribe handling.

capabilities.name: Scheduled / background jobs
capabilities.description: Run automations on a timer or after an event (e.g. review request 2 days after a job).

capabilities.name: Scheduling & calendar sync
capabilities.description: Availability rules, time zones, Google/Outlook calendar sync.

capabilities.name: Online payments & invoicing
capabilities.description: Payment links, invoices, subscriptions, payment reminders.

capabilities.name: PDF generation
capabilities.description: Quotes, invoices and reports as branded PDFs.

capabilities.name: File storage
capabilities.description: Uploads and document sharing for portals and intake forms.

capabilities.name: Dashboards & reporting
capabilities.description: Charts and KPIs for owners.

capabilities.name: Third-party integrations
capabilities.description: Connect QuickBooks, Google Workspace, Square, HubSpot, etc. via APIs and webhooks.

capabilities.name: Referral tracking
capabilities.description: Unique referral links, attribution and reward tracking.

capabilities.name: AI models
capabilities.description: AI generation and conversation (Tessa, Collaborator, campaign generator, VisionWorkx builder).

capabilities.name: Website editing
capabilities.description: Skills/access to improve client sites on common builders.

capabilities.name: Uptime & error monitoring
capabilities.description: Know when a client build breaks before they do.

capabilities.name: Backups
capabilities.description: Automatic, tested backups of client data.

capabilities.name: Social media publishing
capabilities.description: Post and schedule to Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube.

capabilities.name: Source control
capabilities.description: Code repositories and deployment pipeline.

tools.name: GitHub — Revalor01 org
tools.notes: Repos include sanctum-web, revalor-admin, revalor-kids-hub, revalor-automation, VisionWorkx.

tools.name: Revalor Admin
tools.notes: Social automation per brand (FB/IG/TikTok/YouTube) and AI email campaign generator using live subscribers.

tools.name: revalor-automation / VisionWorkx Automation
tools.notes: Sends booking and lead emails. Confirm the email provider behind it and whether it supports scheduled jobs.

tools.name: VisionWorkx builder
tools.notes: Pivoting from full app generation to embeddable widgets. Widget embed layer not built yet.

tools.name: Primary database
tools.notes: Which database do Sanctum, the admin and VisionWorkx use? Can it host multi-tenant client data?

tools.name: Authentication provider
tools.notes: What handles sign-in for Sanctum and the kids apps (PIN dashboards)? Can it support client businesses and their customers?

tools.name: Email sending provider
tools.notes: Name the provider (e.g. Resend, SendGrid, Postmark). Needed to send from client domains.

tools.name: AI model provider
tools.notes: Powers Tessa, Collaborator and the campaign generator. Confirm provider and voice service.

tools.name: Payment processor
tools.notes: Kids apps take a card for the free trial — confirm the processor. Can it do client invoicing (e.g. Stripe Connect)?
